verdict.rationale: Smithery's documented Triggers only let an MCP server surface upstream events, which the server POSTs directly to a consumer. That is an event-delivery building block, not a product feature where users define rules that automatically fire actions. The connection layer that proxied trigger subscriptions (API, Connect, CLI, SDKs) has also been shut down, and Smithery now remains only as a non-proxied registry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
